name: Spatial transcriptomics cell-type clustering benchmark
description: Compares and evaluates cell-type clustering methods on spatially resolved transcriptomics datasets to measure clustering accuracy and robustness.
evaluation_method: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), with optional F1 for marker-based labels
reputation: Moderately used within the spatial-omics / bioinformatics community for method comparison; niche but valued for benchmarking spatial clustering methods.
notes: Small-to-moderate dataset sizes and noisy/partial ground-truth cell-type labels; results sensitive to pre-processing, batch effects and spot resolution. Non-LLM benchmark focused on clustering/analysis metrics.
